articles.summary: UDR, Inc. (the “Company”) (NYSE: UDR ), a leading multifamily real estate investment trust, today announced that Scott McCallum will join the Company as Executive Vice President - Chief Investment Officer (“EVP-CIO”), effective November 5, 2026. He will report to Thomas W. Toomey, Chairman, President, and Chief Executive Officer of UDR. Mr. McCallum will bring an extensive background in public and private real estate with a decade of experience in real estate investments across several property
articles.title: UDR, Inc. Announces Appointment of Scott McCallum as Executive Vice President – Chief Investment Officer
